It publishes the finest peer-reviewed research in all fields of science and technology on the basis of its originality, importance, interdisciplinary interest, timeliness, accessibility, elegance and surprising conclusions. item.title: [9] Encapsulation epitaxy of air-stable 2D superconductors for quantum circuits
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Joel Î-j. Wang, Jing Kong

Authors: Xudong Zheng, Sameia Zaman, Kenan Zhang, et al.

Score 9/10 A_MUST_READ

Why: author whitelist: Riccardo Comin

Tags: #superconduct

Abstract: An ‘encapsulation epitaxy’ mechanism is used to grow air-stable, two-dimensional superconducting films at the interface of a 2D–3D hybrid substrate, holding promise for use in fabrication of superconducting quantum circuitry.

item.title: [7] Pseudogap in a Fermi–Hubbard quantum simulator
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Aaron W. Young, Markus Greiner

Authors: Lev Haldar Kendrick, Anant Kale, Youqi Gang, et al.

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Quantum simulation of the Hubbard model pseudogap, highly relevant to unconventional superconductivity and correlated electrons.

Tags: #experiment #Hubbardmodel #pseudogap

Abstract: A cold-atom quantum simulator reveals the pseudogap metallic state in the Hubbard model, mapping its phase diagram and advancing understanding of doped Mott insulators and high-temperature superconductivity.
